question: The National Film Awards are delivered by which organisation in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Film Awards** are one of the most prestigious film awards in **India**.
 
• It is administered by the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**, **Government of India**.
 
• These awards aim to **encourage the production** of quality films that contribute to the development of Indian cinema.
 
• The awards are presented annually and are considered to be the **highest honor** in the field of cinema in India.
 
• The **Directorate of Film Festivals**, a body under the Ministry, is responsible for organizing the awards and other related events.
 
• The **National Film Awards** were first instituted in **1954**.
 
• Apart from recognizing artistic excellence, the awards also honor films in **regional languages**, promoting India's linguistic and cultural diversity.
 
• There are various categories of awards, including **Best Feature Film, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress, and Lifetime Achievement Awards**.
 
• The awards are decided by a **national jury**, which comprises experts and professionals from the film industry.
 
• The awards ceremony is usually held in New Delhi, and the awards are presented by the **President of India**.
